title_zh: 用交接日志替代含糊的口头安排

scenario.label_zh: 用交接日志替代含糊的口头安排
scenario.goal_zh: 指出口头交接的含糊之处并约定先试用可核对的书面交接流程

context_zh: 两名工作同事改进班次交接，讨论一个尚未实施的日志试用办法。
author: author-phase12-c

sentences.speaker: Freya
sentences.text: Our verbal handover is too vague. Yesterday, I couldn't tell which deliveries were still waiting.

sentences.speaker: Will
sentences.text: I said the paperwork was ready, but I didn't say that the boxes hadn't arrived.

sentences.speaker: Freya
sentences.text: We need a system whereby each outgoing shift lists what's finished and what's still open.

sentences.speaker: Will
sentences.text: I could update the log whilst the incoming person checks the outstanding items.

sentences.speaker: Freya
sentences.text: Then both people can ask about anything that doesn't match.

sentences.speaker: Will
sentences.text: Shall we try that for a week rather than make it a permanent rule straight away?

sentences.speaker: Freya
sentences.text: Yes. We'll review the log together next Friday and see what needs changing.
